attr.title: Crusader: No Remorse
attr.desc: Reimplementation of the Crusader: No Remorse (Origin, 1995) engine in C++/SDL2. Requires the original game data.
attr.inst: Copy the files of your own copy of Crusader: No Remorse (French 1.08 or US 1.23: STATIC, USECODE, SOUND, FLICS, CRUSADER.EXE...), or the CD .iso image, to ports/crusader/data. The iso is extracted on first launch.
